dedupe_keys.name: gtfs jp standard bus information format of japan mlit

description: GTFS-JP, the standard bus information format, is a common format for exchanging information between Japanese bus operators and users such as route search services. The GTFS.JP site states that MLIT has been standardising it since 2016, that it is based on GTFS, the de facto standard for public transport data, and that it is designed to suit both operators and developers; the latest specification and guidelines are on MLIT's pages. Open data in GTFS-JP have begun to be published across Japan, and any application that supports the format can load them. Coverage: Japan. Format and access: a public specification and guidance. Licence and cost: free. Caveats: the site is in Japanese and the specification details sit on MLIT pages. It supports network flow models of Japanese bus networks built from GTFS-JP feeds. It relates to the Japanese GTFS open data list, the GTFS specification and JR East GTFS in the catalogue.
